name: concurrency_exceeded_is_never_retried
description: A credential may have two agent runs going. A third start answers 429 quota.concurrency_exceeded with Retry-After: 30, within the cap, which would be slept and retried for any other 429. A run takes minutes, so the wait rarely frees a slot: it is raised at once, on a keyed route too, as its own concept.

body.title: Too many runs at once
body.detail: This credential already has 2 runs going. Wait for one to finish, then try again.
